privacy.publisherBody: “Pastek Art” app — a guided creative ritual. Publisher: Guillot / Pastek Art. Contact: {{email}}.
privacy.dataBody1: No user account is needed. Your rituals (impulse, technique, exercise, photo, reflection) and your starters are saved automatically to the Creative Thread, locally on your device via AsyncStorage.
privacy.dataBody2: You can export and restore your Creative Thread from the settings: the file stays with you (Drive, email, etc.) and is never sent to our servers.
privacy.dataBody3: When you ask for an AI reflection, your photo is compressed and sent to our API server (Vercel), which passes it to Hugging Face for analysis. It is not kept on the server after processing. Starters that don't use AI (palette, emotions, nuances) send nothing to the server.
privacy.purposeBody: Generating creative exercises and offering a kind reading of your work. No data resale, no advertising profiling.
privacy.legalBasisBody: Legitimate interest and delivery of the service you asked for. You can use the app without ever sending a photo to the AI.
privacy.rightsBody: Access, correction, erasure: remove traces from the Creative Thread, use “Erase everything on this device” in the settings, or uninstall the app. Any questions: {{email}}.
privacy.processorsBody: API hosting: Vercel (vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy). AI models: Hugging Face (huggingface.co/privacy) — inference only, with no training on your content through this app. API keys stay on the server side.
privacy.cookiesBody: The web app sets no advertising cookies. Only your browser's local storage may be used, for the Creative Thread and your preferences.
